title: Finding Middle C & Ergonomic Posture
description: Master Middle C key identification, neutral forearm leveling, and 150°+ wrist alignment.

theory_cards.title: Identifying Middle C
theory_cards.content: Middle C (C4) sits immediately to the left of the two-black-key cluster near the center of your keyboard.

quiz.question: Which key cluster identifies Middle C?

title: The C Major Triad
description: Learn polyphonic chord execution combining C4, E4, and G4 with real-time chromagram analysis.

theory_cards.title: Building the C Major Chord
theory_cards.content: Play C4 (Root), E4 (Major Third), and G4 (Perfect Fifth) simultaneously while maintaining ergonomic posture.

quiz.question: Which notes construct the C Major Triad?

title: Basic Rhythm & Quarter Notes
description: Develop precise tempo control tapping quarter notes at 80 BPM.

theory_cards.title: Understanding Quarter Notes
theory_cards.content: In 4/4 time, each quarter note receives exactly one beat. Press the Spacebar in time with the metronome.
